_comment: Copy to data/admin.json (gitignored) and edit. This file is the registered administrator: who Huginn tells when the guard finds something. Nothing here is secret EXCEPT ntfy.topic — treat that like a password, since anyone who knows it receives your alerts. The SMTP password is NOT stored here; it comes from $HUGINN_SMTP_PASSWORD or data/secrets/smtp.key.
name: alex
_quiet_hours: Local hours, wraps midnight. Holds WARNINGS only — a critical alert always delivers, because 04:00 is exactly when an ARP-spoofed gateway matters most. Set both to null to disable.
_ntfy: Push to a phone. No password stored. Install the ntfy app, subscribe to your topic, and pick a LONG random topic name — it is the only thing protecting it.
_email: Archivable, but stores a password on this machine. Prefer ntfy unless you specifically want mail.
